source_title: Civilization #43:  The Structure of Scientific Revolutions
summary: This April 2025 Scientific Revolutions lecture is already-public support for Jiang's science-as-method-bureaucracy arc: Dante and monotheism make truth knowable through imagination and doubt, Bacon institutionalizes doubt, and mature science then risks becoming the kind of gatekeeping bureaucracy that would reject Galileo, Newton, or Einstein.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: modern science would no longer welcome Galileo, Newton, or Einstein because the system created by revolutionary discovery now filters out strange, abrasive, faith-driven innovators.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Bureaucracy page already uses this source to anchor the mechanism where a mature procedure preserves the institution while blocking the kind of genius that founded it.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Bacon's model makes science a bureaucracy of hypothesis, experiment, data analysis, replication, and peer scrutiny.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Religion As Administrative Filter page already uses this source for scientific doubt as a modern trust/filter code: method selects who may enter the truth-producing system.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the science case in Bureaucracy As Institutional Death. Science begins as a productive bureaucracy of doubt, but over-specialization, political funding, opaque instruments, weak outside accountability, and gatekeeping turn it into an institution that may exclude its own founding type of genius.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Bureaucracy owns institutional self-preservation, gatekeeping, specialization, and blocked renewal. Education owns classroom formation; Power owns science as a symbol that becomes lived reality; Dead World owns material-only ontology.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the scientific-doubt filter case. Hypothesis, experiment, data analysis, replication, and peer review select trusted operators by method rather than priestly office, then risk hardening into credential gates.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Administrative Filter owns the trust code and operator-selection mechanism. Reason As Replacement Religion owns secular truth-making/salvation work when science or reason inherits religion's civil dogma.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Dante genealogy as secondary Poetry pressure only when the page compares poetry as civilizational access: Dante makes imagination a human duty and gives modernity a spiritual permission structure that later science inherits.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns imagination and Dante's form as access. This source should not reopen the June 2026 Paradiso compression or create a standalone Dante Modernity page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as boundary pressure for Dead World: this lecture contrasts premodern spiritual harmony with modern material manipulation and later names dark energy as a label for ignorance, but its active public mechanism is scientific institution, not materialism-as-governance.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Dead World owns the ontology where scientific materialism makes soul and consciousness unreal. Bureaucracy owns the mature research institution that blocks renewal even when science remains methodologically powerful.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep the Newton/Christian-Zionism ending as Eschatology routing pressure only after comparison with stronger prophecy-as-plan sources: Jiang turns Newton's 2060 calculation and return-to-Jerusalem condition into the warning that prophecy can become a plan when powerful believers use money, influence, and status to make it true.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns prophecy becoming role-script or plan. Secret Society owns hidden coordination only with stronger evidence; Prediction owns the 2060/date object only if later ledger work needs it.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-04-01, this lecture supplies the science case already public on Bureaucracy and Religion As Administrative Filter: Bacon's procedural doubt explains rapid progress before the same form hardens into gatekeeping and loss of genius.

This source is an April 2025 classroom formulation of Dante as a hinge for modernity before later Great Books Paradiso sources. Keep it as a Scientific Revolution genealogy, not another Paradiso public append.
The Newton ending records a dated classroom version of prophecy-as-plan: Jiang treats 2060 as less important than the existence of powerful people who try to make a sacred return sequence happen.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: Bureaucracy As Institutional Death and Religion As Administrative Filter already cite this source and preserve stable anchors for the science-as-bureaucracy mechanism.

If provenance maintenance follows, link only the exact episode read marks for `a system of doubt and criticism`, Bacon's process-bureaucracy, and modern science rejecting Galileo/Newton/Einstein to existing lens points; do not bulk-link every science or Dante mark.
Do not create standalone Science, Scientific Revolution, Structure Of Scientific Revolutions, Dante Modernity, Galileo, Newton, Einstein, Christian Zionism, or 2060 pages from this source alone.

A later concept-cluster review could compare this source with Godhead/monotheism, Reason As Replacement Religion, and Dead World materialism sources before deciding whether science-as-religion needs an atlas note; this intake alone does not justify an atlas mutation.
